source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: The National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1 provides detailed information on the circumstances surrounding sudden infant deaths, including demographic data and potential risk factors such as substance abuse history and child maltreatment. However, it lacks specific variables for postconceptional age, maternal smoking status during pregnancy, preterm birth status, breastfeeding at discharge, geographic location, and various physiological measures relevant to experimental studies.
